ModMetaData.name: CE Fix: IsHunkering NRE
ModMetaData.author: Meidocho (local patch)
ModMetaData.description:
Narrow compatibility net for Combat Extended builds that lack the upstream fixes. On CE builds that already contain them (active local fork, future upstream) both patches are inert.
1) Finalizer on CompSuppressable.IsHunkering: converts a NullReferenceException from pawn.CurJob being null into "not hunkering". No CE method body is replaced. 2) Postfix on CompTend.TryGiveTacticalJob: removes only an already-built TendSelf job when another pawn has reserved the target. The original method runs fully first, so flee-for-cover results pass through untouched and no job is ever assigned here.
See docs/ce_fix_ishunkering_nre.md for validation and details.
